scientific_interpretation: Function-level canonicity alone did not make this exposed W05 compact under the preregistered ROBDD variable order. The candidate reached the one-million-node frozen cap during incremental CNF construction after 48 completed clause conjunctions, before any existential quantification and before any semantic verifier was permitted to run. The large unique-table hit count shows substantial canonical reuse, but the retained canonical function graph still grew beyond the envelope. This localizes the next discovery question to ordering/build-width sensitivity rather than establishing a semantic failure of ROBDDs as a family.
R22_purpose: On exposed W05 only, preregister a finite family of structure-only variable-order rules before execution and measure build-phase ROBDD growth without semantic truth access. Determine whether the R21 node wall is specific to the frozen order or persists across independently defined structural orders.
R22_firewall: W05 remains exposed discovery material only
order family must be frozen before any R22 candidate execution
orders may use formula structure only; no truth, SAT, DPLL, bridge assignment enumeration, or verifier feedback
same ROBDD reduction/APPLY semantics for every order
do not choose a winner using semantic truth
any surviving order must later be frozen before semantic control and fresh unseen promotion
claim_ceiling: R21 is one exposed-world, one-order resource result. ROBDD size is order-sensitive in general; this result is not a lower bound for all ROBDD orders or all canonical function representations, and it gives no SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP conclusion.
